MORE THAN AN EVENT

Make space
for yourself.

Step away from the rush of everyday life and into an evening created around wellness, connection and celebration.

The Sphere Wellness Carnival brings together mindful experiences, movement, sound, nourishing food, music and community — creating a space where you can slow down, reconnect and enjoy the moment.

“Sometimes, you simply need a space to pause, breathe deeply, meet new people and leave feeling a little lighter.”

THE EXPERIENCE

Come for the experience.
Stay for the feeling.

An evening thoughtfully brought together around well-being, community and celebration.

  • Mindful Experiences

    Moments designed to help you slow down, reconnect and be present.

  • Breath & Movement

    A guided Breath Walk to help you reconnect with yourself.

  • Sound Healing

    An immersive experience created around relaxation and mindful connection.

  • Nourishing Food

    A curated dinner to enjoy alongside meaningful conversations.

  • Sober Party

    Music, movement and celebration — without alcohol.

  • Community & Connection

    Meet like-minded people and create new connections.

WHO IS IT FOR?

Come as you are.

Women & Couples are welcome. Whether you want to slow down, reconnect, meet new people, explore wellness, enjoy good food or simply dance freely — there is space for you at The Sphere.

GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked
questions.

What is The Sphere Wellness Carnival? +

A wellness-led social experience bringing together mindful activities, sound healing, food, music and community.

When and where is the event? +

20 December 2026, from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM at Jenney's Residency, Coimbatore.

Do I need prior wellness experience? +

No. The experience is designed to be accessible to participants.

Is alcohol served? +

No. The evening concludes with a sober party featuring music, movement and social experiences.

Can I attend alone? +

Yes. The event is designed to encourage community and meaningful connections.

Is dinner included? +

Dinner is part of the event schedule.
